title: One Open Care Management Episode per Member
content:
**Desk guidance, member services center.** A member holds one Care Management episode at a time: the most open episodes one member may hold is 1.

## The rule

A new referral opens an episode only when the member has no episode in referred, outreach, active or on hold status.

An episode that has closed does not count against this rule; every other status an episode can carry — referred, in outreach, active, or on hold during a stay — does.

## What the records must show

- The basis is the member's Care Management episodes as the system records them, identified by the member, and their status at the moment before the new referral is registered. What the caller says about an earlier episode does not replace the recorded status.
- Each new referral is a separate episode with its own referral date; the rule looks at every episode recorded for the same member, whatever its tier.

## Status of an existing episode against the rule (hypothetical member)

| Status of an episode already on the member's record | One-open-episode condition for a new referral |
|---|---|
| Referred | Not met |
| Outreach | Not met |
| Active | Not met |
| On hold | Not met |
| Closed | Met, as far as that episode is concerned |

A member whose record shows one closed episode and nothing else meets the condition. A member whose record shows a closed episode and an episode on hold does not, because the episode on hold is open.

## Points of judgement

- *Does a different tier make a difference?* No. The rule counts the member's open episodes in Care Management as a whole, so an open Healthy Living Support episode stands in the way of a new referral to Complex Case Management just as an open Complex Case Management episode would.
- *Does an episode on hold count as open?* Yes. On hold is one of the four statuses in which an episode blocks a new referral.
